correctness.rationale: For R=Z/p^eZ, primitive vector directions form P¹(R) with p^{e-1}(p+1) elements, each direction has q=p^e cosets of q points. Every nonzero difference has a unique valuation r<e, permitting a containing free line; distinct reduction-mod-p direction lines through either endpoint and a parallel unused coset yield the other three traces, hence every pair shattered. For three collinear points, choose a pair of minimum p-valuation parameter difference; its affine R-line span must contain the third, prohibiting a size-2-only trace. Ldim pencil=e since membership of an extra point within a pencil is a nested direction cylinder in the p-adic direction hierarchy, and strict positive query cylinders cannot refine >e times; depth-e witness uses at least two children at each level. A punctured pencil also retains depth e (first-level p+1>=3 children). Querying a first gives one full and one punctured pencil, making global Ldim=e+1; upper from positive-branch pencil. Independent finite line enumerations: (p,e)=(2,1),(2,2),(3,1) have respectively 6,24,12 distinct lines as expected, consistent with the pinned finite checker. These finite cases do not imply the universal claim.
residual_risks: Bounded finite checks are only corroboration; universal quantifiers follow from the cited analytic proof.

Their VC=2 but Littlestone=e+1 shows a sharp unbounded learnability separation with ring nilpotency depth; the exact support polynomial and complete pencil classification supply meaningful structural information not available from small-instance census.
